title: System Health
description: The Go application's own runtime metrics: heap/memory usage, goroutine count, CPU usage. (Container-level cAdvisor metrics were left out of scope, since they don't run reliably on Docker Desktop.)

options.content: **Go Application (app)** — runtime metrics provided automatically by the Prometheus client library, with no code changes needed.

panels.title: Go Application — Heap (Memory) Usage
panels.description: go_memstats_alloc_bytes: heap memory currently in active use. go_memstats_heap_inuse_bytes: heap space the Go runtime has taken from the OS and is holding onto (not yet returned to the OS) — the gap between the two shows how much 'idle' space the GC is holding.

panels.title: Go Application — Goroutine Count
panels.description: go_goroutines: the number of goroutines currently running. A steadily, continuously climbing line is a sign of a 'goroutine leak' (goroutines started somewhere never finish) — it's expected to fluctuate within a stable band.

panels.title: Go Application — CPU Usage
panels.description: From the process_cpu_seconds_total counter: the CPU time used by the application, as a percentage of one core (100% = fully saturating 1 core).
